scope: Illustrative assumed operating characteristics of equally weighted participant-mean attribution accuracy; no empirical pilot or sample-size recommendation.
assumption_notes: All participants meet an already fixed observed eligibility rule
K is fixed and equal within each scenario
Positive within-person dependence follows a beta-binomial mixture
Dropout is participant-level and independent of outcomes
No relation between the simulated score and conscious access is assumed
No baseline covariate adjustment or power for a linguistic-mechanism test is simulated
